description: A utility library of functions built specific for Net3000.ca applications.
releaseNotes: 10.0.45: Social feed posts join the shared outbound guard (net3000-ca/applications#5497): DemoOutboundChannel.Social, DemoOutboundGuard.MayPostToSocialFeed, lib.MayPostToSocialFeed, and the SocialSuppressedTitle / SocialSuppressedMessage copy every publish path reports. A Facebook or LinkedIn feed post for an account with IsDemoAccount = 1 is suppressed before the provider is called and written to demoWriteAudit as outbound:social; there is no staff allowlist for this channel because a post has no recipient address. Additive API only; non-demo accounts publish exactly as before, and a failed demo-flag lookup allows the post. 10.0.44: net3000.common.Services.ThemeAuthoring.ThemeViewCodes - the theme view codes the Accounts renderer asks for (the alias table plus the codes loaders request verbatim), moved out of the Accounts web app so the netarea theme screens map applicationViews.viewName onto a real code instead of creating views nothing renders (net3000-ca/applications#5496). Additive API only; alias contents and renderer resolution order are unchanged. 10.0.43: BuildInfo (Current, ShortCommit) and IEndpointRouteBuilder.MapBuildInfo(), an anonymous never-cached GET /build-info returning the entry assembly's git commit, version, build time and environment, so a staging verification pass can confirm which build it is testing (net3000-ca/applications#5413). Additive API only. 10.0.42: Task and credit hours are exact decimals (net3000-ca/applications#5392). tsk_tasks.hours, tsk_tasks.billableHours and tsk_credit.hours change from double? to decimal? and map to DECIMAL(9,2); accounts-2 and accounts-2_staging must have run SQL Updates/2026-10-26-5392-task-credit-hours-decimal.sql before a consumer loads this version, or EF materialisation of those rows fails. Breaking for external consumers that read or assign these properties as double (the accounting app, net3000-ca/accounting#184): recompile against this package and go live in the same release window as the SQL, refreshing the zaccounting tsk_* cross-catalog views. The views pass the columns straight through, so an older consumer reading them breaks as soon as the SQL runs. 10.0.41: Behaviour change for external consumers (net3000-ca/applications#5152): lib.account no longer selects a tenant from ?account=<id> on every request. The numeric query id now counts only on GET/HEAD endpoints that carry the new AllowAccountIdQueryAttribute (or a host that adds AllowAccountIdQueryConvention); everywhere else it is ignored and resolution falls through to the account token, cookies, host and Origin. A host that relied on ?account= must mark its read-only endpoints or pass ?accounttoken=. The numeric account header is unchanged. New: AllowAccountIdQueryAttribute, AllowAccountIdQueryConvention and AccountIdQueryPolicy (IsAllowed, TryGetAllowedAccountId, LogIdSelector), which log every id-selected request under the net3000.common.AccountIdSelector category. 10.0.40: Private video hosting on Cloudflare Stream, CM side (net3000-ca/applications#4275): cm_videos gains streamUid / streamStatus / durationSeconds / streamThumbnailUrl plus the derived isPrivateHosted flag, and net3000.cloudflareStream.StreamTenantTag carries the creator and meta.env tags that keep live and staging from deleting each other's Stream videos. Additive API only; videos without a streamUid are unchanged. 10.0.39: Principal identity resolution refuses disabled, deleted, and missing logins before reconstructing identity from existing JWT/cookie claims (#5309). Applies to lightweight and full-data loading; existing APIs preserved. 10.0.38: Job Board employer authorization accepts an entitled membership-backed public jb Team; public login checks application eligibility before issuing a session (#2614). Existing logMeIn signatures preserved. 10.0.37: ScriptLoaderCacheService writes its cache-version stamps with appCode null instead of the nonexistent "core" application, so JS/CSS and asset saves no longer fail on the settings-to-applications foreign key after committing (net3000-ca/applications#1129). No API change. 10.0.36: Public password-reset emails route non-rendering platform hosts to iframes and preserve account-token context (#5286). 10.0.35: PlaceholderInput (ContainsMarker, FirstMarkedField, Refusal, Message) detects buyer text that could become a placeholder token, so entry points can refuse it (net3000-ca/applications#5140). Text outside printable ASCII is re-checked after dropping the characters the merge's InvariantCultureIgnoreCase comparison ignores (soft hyphen, zero-width space, controls) and NFKC normalization. Additive. 10.0.34: One friendly link per page per account (net3000-ca/applications#5133): lib.FindFriendlyLinkConflictAsync, lib.TrySetLinkAsync, FriendlyLinkTargets, FriendlyLinkConflict and FriendlyLinkSaveResult. setLinkAsync / setLink now refuse a slug another page on the account already owns instead of overwriting that page's row, and a blank slug with no pagePath is a no-op. 10.0.33: NoPlaceholderAttribute and exclude overloads of replacePlaceholders keep secret-bearing properties out of a placeholder merge; account.settings is marked (net3000-ca/applications#5130). The existing replacePlaceholders signatures are unchanged and forward to the new overloads, so compiled callers still bind. Two output changes, not additive: a merge over an account row no longer substitutes ##account.settings## / ##settings## (it blanks them), and a null or unparseable DateTime now blanks ##nametime## where it previously left the token standing - visible in subjects and in page-content merges, which removePlaceHolders does not clean. 10.0.32: AdEventRecorder.ViewerHashSecretConfigName and VerifyViewerHashSecret - host-startup check so Production fails fast without AdNetwork:ViewerHashSecret (net3000-ca/applications#4766). Additive. 10.0.31: Per-theme demo branding (ThemeDemoBranding gate, completeness check and layout overlay) so one demo account can show a different company, logo and phone per theme (net3000-ca/applications#3812, #3816). Additive. 10.0.30: Rate-limit rejections write JSON for fetch/XHR and leave browser navigations empty so status-code pages can redirect to /message/429 (net3000-ca/applications#4537). 10.0.29: Shared account-level outbound guard (net3000-ca/applications#4065): DemoOutboundGuard / DemoOutboundChannel, lib.MaySendOutbound / FilterOutboundRecipients, DemoWriteAuditOutcome.Suppressed. Email, SMS, WhatsApp and push sent for an account with IsDemoAccount = 1 are suppressed and audited (except to the staff allowlist, DemoOutbound:StaffAllowlist, default @net3000.ca / @net3000.co); emailMessage and the SMTP sends in lib / scheduledTasks route through it. Non-demo accounts unchanged; a failed demo-flag lookup allows the send and logs. 10.0.28: Demo sandbox and theme preview shared API (net3000-ca/applications#3812): DemoSandboxScope/DemoSandboxState, lib.IsDemoSandboxed / ClassifyRequestForDemoSandbox / RebindDemoSandboxToCurrentAccount, DemoSandboxSaveInterceptor, DemoSandboxSentinelId / NewDemoSandboxReference / MergeDemoSandboxReference, DemoSandboxSignInResponse / DemoSandboxEmailLinkResponse, accountsDB.IsDemoAccount(accountId) extension, and email/push/payment seams that skip sends on a sandboxed demo request. Additive API only; non-demo requests unchanged. 10.0.27: Add net3000.AdNetwork off-request event pipeline (AdEventQueue, AdEventRecorder, AdEventFlushService, AddAdNetworkEvents) and the content-2 AdEvents entity + contentDB.AdEvents DbSet (net3000-ca/applications#3387). Additive API only. 10.0.26: Add net3000.common.Services.ThemeAuthoring - ThemeAuthoringService (theme save, deep duplicate, HTML-to-blocks view import/re-import, block save, declarative view composition) and ThemePageCodes, moved out of net3000.core ThemesController so the AccountsMCP theme tools share the admin rules (net3000-ca/applications#3085). Additive API only. 10.0.25: Add lib.ResolveSocialImage / lib.GetSocialImagePool - shared og:image resolution (metaTagFeatureImage -> featureImage -> account socialImagePool setting) for every app's meta-tag builder. Pool is opt-in by absence: accounts with no socialImagePool row resolve to null and emit no og:image, as before. Additive API only. 10.0.24: Depend on Portable.BouncyCastle 1.9.0 instead of BouncyCastle.NetCore 2.2.1. Both shipped a file named BouncyCastle.Crypto.dll with incompatible identities (1.9.0.0 signed vs 0.0.0.0 unsigned); last-writer-wins resolution broke WebPush's strong-named bind on deployed hosts. No API change - the crypto code compiles unchanged and ciphertext is byte-for-byte identical. Also drops dangling BouncyCastle.Crypto and HtmlAgilityPack assembly-reference HintPaths pointing into gitignored bin folders. 10.0.23: Add IListUnsubscribeLookup contract so app audience providers can subtract per-list unsubscribes without referencing mailingListDB. 10.0.22: Bootstrap 5 dual-compatibility in emitted admin nav markup - the two nav-dropdown emitters now emit data-bs-toggle alongside data-toggle so the markup drives dropdowns under both Bootstrap 4 and 5 (epic net3000-ca/applications#1764, issue #1795). No API changes. 10.0.21: Restore assembly name to 'common' (10.0.20 shipped as net3000.common.dll, breaking Net3000.Content's contentDB reference).
